comparison.objective: Select one M4×20 screw matching a request and hand it off in a tray; candidate removes tangs from installed M2.5 inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual size matching, grasping one loose screw, and tray placement versus recessed coaxial tool insertion, bimanual hammering, safe withdrawal, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one correct screw within 4 mm of the tray floor versus four fractured tangs physically contained with all inserts retained and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Matching and transferring a loose fastener does not test finishing an installed threaded insert by controlled fracture.
